_about: Published upstream facts that envelope_bounds_verify.py depends on, extracted ONCE from the arXiv source so the checker is self-contained and a clean public clone (which does not ship the copyrighted .tex) can run the suite. Each fact records the exact arXiv identifier and the 1-based line number in the source .tex it was transcribed from. When the .tex IS present locally, envelope_bounds_verify.py re-checks these facts against it as an OPTIONAL provenance step.
